item.content:encoded:
[22:34] thedeadlymoose dammit now I have to type up some of this in a comment lmao
[22:35] thedeadlymoose regardless, compelling enough to make me accidentally do live commentary
[22:35] thedeadlymoose so not bad at all

let's see if I can summarize:

  • A couple details are great: Donkey jawbone in particular. I get that reference
  • The Mary Ann stuff is really compelling. The major issue is that of contrivance: Mary Ann needs to go through the "denial" stage of grief and question why Moloch would possibly have picked her. Ideally, there should be a story reason (if there is, I don't see it), but you can get away with covering that up with good enough handwaving. (No one in the randomly chosen 0.001 percent pool believes they'd be in that 0.001 percent — that sort of thing. Still a contrivance, but one the reader should be okay with).
  • The stuff that's not Mary Ann (or DeMontfort's opening bit, or the excellent bit in the quotebox story… let me rephrase, the stuff that's not Mary Ann in the second half of the story) is somewhat underwhelming. You need it structurally, but it should be pushed more.
  • Salah leaving her behind… isn't really working. Again, it's the right story choice, but it needs to work better. He should respect her enough to leave her behind, which is exactly what happens, but… maybe play it slightly differently. Hm.
  • The event in the ending line felt a bit too obligatory (and I called it long before it happened), but the section works enough for it to be compelling.

Overall, yeah, this is good. You pulled it off. +1

item.content:encoded:
My fucking god.

This story, this whole goddamn canon has been amazing to read, and is by far one of the best series of tales I've ever read. Hell, I'd be willing to go so far as to say it's one of the best series of stories I've read ever.

Djoric, man, I wish I had half the talent you had when it comes to writing. You made characters that I sympathize with, characters I want to see succeed and care about. You wrote the situations they were put in flawlessly, made sure every ounce of emotion that could come from each trial shine through. You characterized the groups of interest in ways I hadn't even begun to fathom, and yet they all still work and make sense. You wove a web of interconnectivity between the groups and the skips, and not one element fails to work.

For fuck's sake, you integrated jokes like Soulberg and Chowderclef into the story and not a single one feels out of place!

I wish I could do more for this than just upvote it, I really do. +1, you insane and glorious bastard, and I'll be waiting eagerly for when you decide you want to enthrall us once more.

What have I become
My sweetest friend

goes away
In the end
And you could have it all
My empire of dirt
I will let you down
I will make you hurt.

God bless you, dude. God forgive you. I might have originally created the HI, but you, Sir, you made them what they are. It's been my pleasure to read this series, to help in what little way I could, to contribute some of my characters to it when they were needed. You've written something that would be remembered, and that is no small feat.
